Meta.title: BorsaView | بورسا فيو
Meta.description: An informational and educational platform for economics and financial markets.

hero.title: Understand financial markets clearly
hero.subtitle: BorsaView brings news, analysis and learning content together in one place, in a clear and simple style for beginners and experienced followers alike.

markets.title: A quick look at the markets
markets.desc: Pick the market you care about to learn about it and follow what matters.

gold.title: Gold
gold.desc: Everything about the precious metal: what moves its price, how to read its movement, and following XAU/USD.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.desc: Get to know the major currencies and pairs, and what drives exchange rates.

stocks.title: Stocks & Indices
stocks.desc: Global indices and major stocks, with a simple guide to reading them.

news.title: Economic news
news.desc: We pick the key stories and link to the original sources so you can read them there.
news.emptyDesc: Once the first story is added, you will find it here with its source and link.

analysis.title: Analysis & insights
analysis.desc: Clear market analysis and commentary, for informational and educational purposes.
analysis.emptyDesc: The latest analysis will be shown here as soon as it is published.

academy.title: Learn the markets from scratch
academy.desc: Simple slide-based lessons that explain concepts step by step.
academy.body: Clear learning slides that help you understand financial markets with no prior experience.

economy.title: Economy & Thought
economy.desc: Articles and ideas that go beyond the numbers to explain the economy.
economy.body: A space for articles and ideas that explain how the economy works and why markets move.

Footer.about: An informational and educational finance and economics platform.
Footer.notice: BorsaView is not a broker and does not execute trades. Content is for informational and educational purposes.
